mechanism: Persistent Constraints preflight and regression gate

constraints.rule: Selected installation, opening, closure, and tail-removal Action Units must reach their corresponding visible results before a cut.
Preserve install -> assembled open -> closed -> carry scene -> tail detach/port reveal -> independent hero progression without unexplained regression.
The carabiner shot proves a hanging/carry configuration only; it does not prove the clipping-on action.
Tail removal proves port access only; never claim charging success, speed, or connection.
No directional CTA gesture exists in the reviewed material; use Hero plus non-directional verbal CTA and do not fabricate pointing/UI.
Shorten VO before any slight TTS speed adjustment; never extend, loop, or repeat visuals to fill narration.
